title: Casa Trinitaria@ Puntas, Rincon
description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. This unique backyard house is nestled between an avocado tree and a breadfruit tree making it a special place. Enjoy our backyard with pool (shared with Casa Tamboril), bbq and outdoor shower and your majestic views from your private balconies. We are 0.2 miles from Pools beach and steps from Red Flamboyan restaurant.If you have a bigger group at Casa Tamboril you can rent Casa Trinitaria ( 4 persons max)The spaceCasa Trinitaria is nestled in our backyard and designed to offer a unique tree house feeling with plenty of outdoor space to enjoy the ocean views.Our chefs kitchen is well equipped to cook up whatever you want. You have 2 smart TVs and fast WiFi to enjoy streaming all your favorites. The pool is just a step from your doorstep so you can be close to the kids in the pool. We offer 2 outdoor showers for your enjoyment.Pool is shared with guests from Casa Tamboril if you are in the same group. You can also enjoy Ocean Views from the shared Roof top. Shared spaces (backayard/pool/roof top) must be kept clean at all times after use.Guest accessGuests have a private entrance to the house coming in from 413 rd and One parking spot in our lot. We offer 4 beach chairs, beach towels and a beach umbrella. You are less than 0.2 miles from Pools Beach and walking distance to one of the best restaurants in Puntas (breakfast, lunch and dinner!)Other things to noteShared spaces (backyard and rooftop) must be kept clean and in order. Our neighbors live/sleep next to our back yard no loud noises in that area after 930pm

description: Welcome to Villa Salvador — your beachfront escape in Rincón, Puerto Rico. A 2BR villa w/ den, 2.5 baths in a gated resort community just steps from the beach. You’ll enjoy breezy terraces, ocean sunsets, and access to a pool, basketball/tennis/pickleball courts and more. The villa is equipped with solar panels for peace of mind, making it the perfect mix of comfort, reliability, and Caribbean charm. Book your stay today and let Villa Salvador be your front-row seat to paradise.The spaceVilla Salvador is a stylish beachside mediterranean style villa in a gated resort community just steps from the sand, perfect for families, couples, or groups. Guests enjoy spacious living areas, a fully equipped kitchen, breezy terraces, and access to a sparkling pool. With ocean sunsets every evening and Rincon’s surf, dining, and nightlife minutes away, it’s your ideal Caribbean getaway.Villa Salvador – Quick Highlights • 🌊 Steps from the beach • 🛏️ 2 bedrooms + den with twin beds (sleeps up to 6) • 🛁 2.5 bathrooms • 🏊 Pool access • 🌅 Terrace with ocean breezes & sunset views • 🍳 Fully equipped kitchen + outdoor sitting (1st and 2nd floor) • 📶 Fast WiFi & workspace (remote-work friendly) • 🏀 Basketball, 🎾 tennis & pickleball courts • 🔋 Equipped with solar panels for added reliability • 👨‍👩‍👧 Perfect for families, couples, or friends • 🏄 Close to Rincón surf, dining & nightlifeGuest accessGuests have full use of Villa Salvador (2 bedrooms - one has a mezannine with an extra queen size bed, a den with twin beds, 2.5 bathrooms, kitchen, terrace & dining areas). Within our gated resort community, you’ll also enjoy shared access to the beach, pool, basketball, tennis and pickleball courts. 🚗 Parking: Free parking is available inside the community. Identified parking spaces 3-20 and 3-21 in front of unit. Door opens with a key inside a lockbox located at the villa’s main entrance. Lockbox combination provided after booking.Other things to noteWe’ve stocked the villa with a few complimentary essentials to make your stay extra comfortable:✨ Toothbrush & toothpaste (in case you forgot 😉)✨ Shampoo & conditioner✨ Shower cap✨ Fresh soap & body lotion💡 Bathrobes are provided for your comfort during your stay but are not complimentary items — please leave them behind when you check out.Villa Salvador is equipped with solar panels, helping ensure a more reliable stay during your visit.

description: Rent half of this beachfront duplex in the lovely Sea Beach area. (Other side also available…just ask). Best swimming beach in Rincon. Short walk to town and shopping. Many wonderful restaurants close by. Sunday Farmers Market and Thursday Art Walk. Just sit out front on the 16' x 35' porch and watch the beautiful sunsets nightly. Back up solar powered battery for the essentials in case of a power outage. Rincon...the "Riviera" of Puerto Rico!The spaceThis home has been loved by our big family and friends for decades. We have enjoyed countless vacations here watching and listening to the ocean and enjoying swimming in the warm Caribbean Sea. The nightly sunset tradition of a cool piña colada is everyone's favorite. Air conditioning in bedrooms only. We have hammock hooks, so bring your own hammock! (Hammocks are NOT provided) This home is a duplex and this listing is HALF of the house. The 2 sides are separate, and the other side is rarely used, or you can rent both sides which can be joined up by opening an interior door. Certain holiday weeks require a minimum 7 day stay AND a full house (both sides) rental. Each side has 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms (a half bath on one side). One side has a king bed, 2 twins and a couch for sleeping. The other side has a king bed, queen bed and a small couch for sleeping.Guest accessGuests will have access to one side of the duplex. If you rent the entire house, you will have 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms on each side. There is an adjoining interior door you may open or close to create a divider between the two sides.Other things to noteSolar power backup in case of an electric grid outage. (A normal occurrence in PR) Backup power should cover your basic needs, including lights, internet, fans, refrigerator and microwave. Although the air conditioners will work, they drain the backup battery quickly, so please leave them off so you don’t lose all power. The owner will notify you when the grid goes out, if possible, so you are able to manage your energy usage.Some holiday weeks may require a full house rental.

title: Beach Walk in Puerto Bahia #30
description: Escape to Beach Walk Puerto Bahia, a luxurious duplex townhome nestled in a gated community at the stunning Marina Beach. This brand new property boasts a prime location just steps away from the renowned Rincon beach, known for its crystal-clear waters perfect for swimming, paddle boarding, and kayaking. Conveniently close to town and a short drive to some of the best surfing beaches, this townhome has everything you need for an unforgettable vacation.The spaceYou will be impressed by the elegant furnishings and top-of-the-line amenities in this 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath home. The separate TV room is perfect for movie nights and the full-size washer and dryer ensure a hassle-free stay. Your safety is our top priority, so you can relax and unwind in this secure environment. We provide beach towels and chairs for your convenience, and the backyard boasts a tiled patio area with a barbecue, outdoor furniture, and an outdoor shower where you can savor the ocean views.The fully-equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances and all necessary utensils for your cooking convenience. Want more amenities? Our community offers a refreshing swimming pool with a shaded picnic area and restrooms for your enjoyment.Guest accessWake up to breathtaking ocean views from most rooms and fall asleep to the soothing sounds of the waves. The comfortable bed arrangements include a king bed, queen bed, and two twin beds, accommodating up to 6 people. Smoking is not permitted on the property.As an added bonus, our property comes equipped with a generator, ensuring a worry-free stay with uninterrupted electricity in case of any power outages.Other things to notePlease note that we only provide a starter supply of toiletries for your convenience.

title: Casa Luz Main: Pool w/ Ocean & Lighthouse Views

images.caption: Day bed located by dedicated work space

description: Escape to your perfect beach retreat in this newly updated 3-bedroom, 2 1/2-bathroom unit, offering panoramic ocean and lighthouse views! Whether you’re here to unwind by the pool, explore the nearby trails, or soak in the scenic beauty of the coastline, this beautifully remodeled & fully stocked home is an ideal spot for your next home away from home getaway.The house is equipped with a generator & cistern in the event of an outage.The spaceSpectacular Views: Enjoy breathtaking ocean vistas and the iconic Rinon lighthouse right from the comfort of your home. One of the standout features of this home is the impressive balcony that stretches the full length of the house. Accessible from both the living room and dining area, the balcony offers additional dining & outdoor seating, allowing you to enjoy the surrounding views, whether enjoying your morning coffee, whale watching or enjoying the sunset for a peaceful evening, the balcony provides an ideal space for relaxation. Luxury Pool: Take a dip in the brand-new pool, complete with gazebo, grill, lounge chairs, and in-pool bench & stool seating, all to complement a tranquil atmosphere for ultimate relaxation.Trail Access: Step outside and explore the trails leading directly to the beach and lighthouse, offering a serene walk through nature to your own sandy oasis.Modern & Spacious: The unit boasts a sleek, updated interior, spacious living areas equipped with family games and books, a large, fully stocked kitchen, and breathtaking views throughout. Relax in style with tasteful decor and all the comforts of home.Three Bedrooms, two and a half Bathrooms: Ideal for families or groups, with plenty of space to spread out. Five beds total/Sleeps 10. The master suite offers a king bed, a balcony with sweeping views, ample closet space, and a private en-suite bathroom. The unit also includes a cozy Full Bedroom, perfect for guests or family members. This room is outfitted with a comfortable full-sized bed and provides a relaxing, restful space with charming décor and easy access to the main living areas. For added versatility, the unit boasts a unique Bunk Room with two full-sized beds—ideal for families or friends staying together. This room offers a fun, yet comfortable sleeping arrangement with plenty of space for everyone to unwind. Finally, the unit features a delightful Reading Nook/Daybed Area, where you can curl up with a good book or enjoy a peaceful nap. This cozy corner includes a full-size daybed, providing additional flexibility for sleeping arrangements while maintaining an inviting, relaxed vibe.Perfect for Outdoor Lovers: Enjoy this natural paradise with easy hiking/biking trails in your backyard. Perfect for a quick 8 minute walk to surf at Domes or a relaxing 12 minute walk to the Lighthouse to soak in the stunning nature while exploring your surroundings. These trails are used yearly for the famous Puerto Rico MTB Cup, so if you're a biker, this is your dream come true!Location: Conveniently located minutes from Sandy beach, Maria's & Domes beaches, shops, dining, and activities, yet private enough to feel like your own coastal retreat, surrounded by nature. With direct access to trails leading to the beach, and close proximity to the lighthouse, you’ll be immersed in nature while having access to all the best the area has to offer.Book your stay today and experience the beauty of this coastal paradise. Whether you're looking for a quiet retreat or a space to host family and friends, this rental unit offers both comfort and style.*Community outdoor laundry is available under the unit and baby & toddler toys and amenities are available upon request.The pool/ garden/ gazebo are shared spaces for all Casa Luz guests.This property is equipped with an automatic generator that will power on automatically and backup water reserves in the event of a local outage.Guest accessGuests will access to the Main house and all shared spaces.Shared spaces: Pool, Gazebo, Grill, Garden, Domes trail accessOther things to noteThis is a residential neighborhood, so please be respectful of the neighbors who are not on vacation. There are only two parking spots for this unit, as parking in the area is limited. The parking is a bit tight, so Pickup Trucks and Passenger vans will not be able to park. Ideal Compact, mid-size, small SUV or crossover. Anything exceeding a normal vehicle length will not be able to park in the driveway or on this streetWe are located on the western point of the island. We are2.5 hours from SJU Airport, 35 minutes from both BQN & MAZ airports and 1.5 hours from PSE Airport in Ponce. To avoid the drive from San Juan, a Cape Air flight flies directly multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.

description: Reserve your piece of paradise and book the entire Boarding House. Ocean views from our beautiful roof top terrace with a quiet & peaceful neighborhood vibe. Gorgeous views, comfortable beds and nearby to great restaurants and beaches. *Owner lives on property.The spacePLEASE READ HOUSE MANUEL PRIOR TO BOOKING THIS HOMEWe welcome respectful adults looking for a calm & relaxing getaway. This is not a party house. We do not allow any outside visitors, gatherings or parties/events at the home.** You get the entire upstairs house featuring:Avocado Suite - this is our largest apartment with two bedrooms, first bedroom has one queen bed and second bedroom has two queen beds. There is a large living and dining area, kitchen and one bathroom. This room is located on the second level of the home, right next door to the Pineapple Suite. Pineapple suite - this is a spacious one bedroom apartment with one queen size bed, one bathroom, a small kitchen and a comfortable living and dining area. The couch in the living room does pull out into a bed. This room is located on the second level of the home, right next to the Avocado suite.*We do live in an apartment at the home, so although you rent the upper level of the home, myself & my husband will be in the lower level.*The 2 apartments can comfortably sleep up to 8 people.*The 2 upstairs apartments have proven to be a wonderful set up for groups! People have their own private space when they want it but also have larger gathering areas between the two bigger apartments and the rooftop terrace for those times you all want to hang out together.*You will need a car to get around Rincon. We do not have reliable public transportation and Uber does not operate in this area. * We have solar that runs that whole house. We do switch over to the grid overnight. If we should lose power to the grid overnight, we will lose the air conditioners until we start making power again in the morning. In very rare cases we may go a few hours without power. We ask for your patience and understanding if power should go out during your stay. It is completely out of our control and we’ll do our best to keep you comfortable. Thank you!Guest accessGuests have access to all outdoor areas including our rooftop terrace. This rooftop area is a hidden gem and always takes people by surprise! Panoramic views of the ocean for whale watching, grilling out or just napping in the hammock.Other things to notePLEASE NOTE! If you are flying in and out of Aguadilla, please plan accordingly!!! For example if you are flying in and land at 2am on Saturday, you need to book Friday night in order to get into your room at that time. If you don't book the previous night, check in is 3pm or after on the date of your reservation, in this case, on Saturday. I am not able to hold the room for you to check in in the middle of the night/early morning unless you reserve the previous night.
